changelog:
Initial release of the Agent Observability Spec skill.

- Provides detailed templates for trace schema, metrics, sampling, retention, and privacy for observability of AI agent or LLM-based systems in production.
- Defines minimum required spans (root, model, retrieval, tool, guardrail, user signal) to enable full replay and root cause analysis.
- Outlines four metric families (health, cost, quality, behaviour) with thresholds, alerting, and ownership.
- Specifies robust sampling and retention policies for balancing costs and diagnostic utility.
- Includes privacy guidance for logged content and access management.
- Offers anti-patterns and quality checks to ensure durable, actionable observability practices.
